description: This file defines the TaskModel class with static methods to perform CRUD operations on tasks in a database, likely for a task management backend.

classes.name: TaskModel
classes.description: A class providing static methods for creating, retrieving, updating, and deleting tasks in the database.

methods.name: createTask({ title, description, assignedTo, dueDate, parentId, templateId })
methods.description: Creates a new task record in the database with provided details and default status 'todo'.

methods.name: getTasksForUser(userId, role, parentId)
methods.description: Retrieves tasks for a user based on role: parent gets own and kids' tasks; kid gets assigned tasks.

methods.name: updateTaskStatus(taskId, userId, role, newStatus)
methods.description: Updates the status of a task, accessible by the assignee or parent.

methods.name: deleteTask(taskId, parentId)
methods.description: Deletes a specific task, restricted to the parent of the task.

methods.name: updateTask(taskId, parentId, updateFields)
methods.description: Allows the parent to update various fields of a task.

ctags.name: createTask
ctags.pattern: /^  static async createTask({ title, description, assignedTo, dueDate, parentId, templateId }) {$/
ctags.signature: ({ title, description, assignedTo, dueDate, parentId, templateId })

ctags.name: updateTaskStatus
ctags.pattern: /^  static async updateTaskStatus(taskId, userId, role, newStatus) {$/
